name: tree_v1
doc: A tree (design/systems.md, Trees): the game asks for a species, age, and season at a position with the local wind; the rig grows the skeleton, the mesh wraps it, colorize paints it, and the animator sways it in the wind or breaks it.

params.name: species
params.doc: A species: one genome from config/tree_v1_genomes/.

params.name: fruit
params.doc: The tree still carries its fruit; clear it when the fruit is picked. Applies only to species whose fruit can be picked (pickable); elsewhere it is disabled.

params.name: stump
params.doc: Only the stump is left. The game sets it once a felled tree's break is over (break_over in its result); the trunk's collision becomes the stump's.

params.name: seed
params.doc: Which of the distinct trees per species, age, and season (the runtime caps how many by quality).

params.name: detail
params.doc: Level of detail; the runtime picks it from distance and quality.

params.name: wind_heading
params.doc: Toward which the wind blows, from +Z toward +X.

params.name: break_time
params.doc: Seconds since the tree broke; negative while it stands. The game starts it (foundry_tree_v1_start_break).
